paused_zero_wakeup.actual: CLOSED as documented limitation (pre-release diagnosis 2026-09-22, packaging/known-limitations.md section 11). Clean replication with the phase-2 row-b method (no exit/simulate flags, manual IPC pause mask=1, 60 s tidsnap raw-delta): 13.5/s process-wide on the current engine (11.8/s pre-hotfix; delta = run variance + transient destroy-poke wakes, all zero-CPU). Top thread ~9.5/s at 0.000% CPU = IPC ServeLoop 100 ms accept slices by design; libmpv-internal threads ~1-1.5/s at 0.000%; all else <=0.16/s. Zero file I/O + zero periodic log lines in-window: decode fully stopped, churn is pure zero-CPU wait slices. Ordered suspects cleared (config event path armed, occlusion disarmed/silent, only conditional/transient SetTimer sites). Silencing the slice = IPC-server redesign (accept-latency + protected IPC v1 path) = non-trivial by the pre-release brief: no refactor, gate recorded NOT MET. Confound on record: --exit-after-ms forces 50 ms cadence via AnySimulateArmed() (~80/s); such runs superseded for cadence.
paused_zero_wakeup.p4_impact: none (no loop/IPC/pause-path change in P4; P4.1 timer fires once then dead)
paused_zero_wakeup.hotfix_impact: destroy/foreground/minimize/locationchange pokes add only transient wakes (150 ms one-shot debounce, early-out when no slot paused); 60 s re-verified 13.5/s vs 11.8/s pre-fix. No periodic timer added.
paused_zero_wakeup.verdict: DOCUMENTED LIMITATION (gate < 1.0/s NOT MET, fix direction recorded, no prod change)

notes.ws_vs_private: SetProcessWorkingSetSize(-1,-1) evicts resident pages (WS) but commits nothing: private bytes are unchanged by the trim. Post-trim WS regrowth is workload-driven (idle-paused ~1.6 MB stable; hwdec playback ~3 MB stable — zero-copy d3d11va decode lives in driver/GPU-shared pool, cf. known-limitations section 3a). PeakWorkingSet64 (158.92 MB) preserves the pre-trim residency bound.
notes.trim_once_proof: engine.log shows exactly one 'working-set trim' line per run (29904->180 KB idle, 151584->184 KB playback); done_ flag + KillTimer make re-trim impossible
